proposed_additions.question: In two-player Combat, what is the order of House Hagal’s combat-bonus reveal and humans’ ordinary Combat Intrigue plays? Does House Hagal get a bonus-card reveal if it has no troop in the Conflict?
proposed_additions.fixed_answer: At the start of Combat, first reveal House Hagal’s combat-bonus card if it has at least one troop in the Conflict (reshuffle and reveal again on Reshuffle). Then humans may play ordinary Combat Intrigue cards before Combat resolves. A troopless House Hagal gets no bonus reveal.
